parameters.content:
## How to use this workflow

### 1. Configure credentials
Click the **Create Sales Order** node and select your Exact Online OAuth2 credentials.

### 2. Fill in your data
Edit the **Set Order Data** node with your actual values:

- **division**: Your Exact Online division code (number)
- **customerGuid**: The GUID of the customer account (OrderedBy) — find this in Exact Online under CRM > Accounts
- **salesOrderLines**: Array of line items, each requiring at minimum an **Item** GUID

### 3. Sales Order Lines fields
Each line item in the `salesOrderLines` array supports:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| Item | guid | Yes | Article/item GUID |
| Description | string | No | Line description |
| Quantity | number | No | Quantity (default 1) |
| UnitPrice | number | No | Price per unit |
| NetPrice | number | No | Net price (overrides calculation) |
| Discount | number | No | Discount % (0-100) |
| VATCode | string | No | VAT code |
| UnitCode | string | No | Unit of measure (kg, pcs, etc.) |
| DeliveryDate | datetime | No | Line delivery date |
| Notes | string | No | Line notes |
| CostCenter | string | No | Cost center code |
| CostUnit | string | No | Cost unit code |
| Project | guid | No | Project GUID |
| Pricelist | guid | No | Price list GUID |

### 4. Header fields

| Field | API Name | Type | Description |
|-------|----------|------|-------------|
| Customer | OrderedBy | guid | **Required** — Customer account GUID |
| Order Date | OrderDate | datetime | Order date |
| Your Reference | YourRef | string | Customer's PO/reference |
| Description | Description | string | Order description |
| Currency | Currency | string | e.g. EUR, USD |
| Payment Condition | PaymentCondition | string | Payment term code |
| Delivery Date | DeliveryDate | datetime | Header delivery date |
| Incoterm | IncotermCode | string | e.g. EXW, FOB, CIF |
| Incoterm Address | IncotermAddress | string | Incoterm location |
| Remarks | Remarks | string | Internal remarks |
| Deliver To | DeliverTo | guid | Delivery account |
| Deliver To Contact | DeliverToContactPerson | guid | Delivery contact |
| Delivery Address | DeliveryAddress | guid | Delivery address |
| Invoice To | InvoiceTo | guid | Invoice account |
| Salesperson | Salesperson | guid | Salesperson GUID |
| Warehouse | WarehouseID | guid | Warehouse GUID |
| Shipping Method | ShippingMethod | guid | Shipping method |
| Discount | Discount | number | Header discount % |
